station.PromisedLand.desc: A hydroponic farm for growing natural food crops. Hectares of earth-type arable land covered by a geodesic dome.
station.PromisedLand.name: Promised Land
station.Proyas.desc: Proyas is located in a region where the spongy surface structure has resulted in numerous rock formations. As a result, ground approaches, suborbital jumps and direct landings from orbit are all extremely dangerous. And even then, only small shuttles can afford to land safely on the small transport pad at Proyas. But why would anyone want to go to such a remote place?
station.Proyas.name: Proyas
station.Purgatory.desc: This is a spaceport on the surface of Mechta. Since Mechta is located in a very high Venusian orbit, this terminal is a convenient stopover point for those moving towards or away from the Sun without stopping on Venus.
station.Purgatory.name: Purgatory
station.QiHelium.desc: H-3 quantum liquid is the main fuel used in the Solar System. Qi Helium-3 is the largest station for processing Helium-3 into quantum liquid. This plant is the only stable source of this fuel within the Inner System.
station.QiHelium.name: Qi Helium-3
station.Rachmaninoff.desc: After Earth was transformed into an environmental paradise, almost all production was moved into orbit. Over time, the practice of building orbital factories proved to be highly profitable. Rachmaninov-Energia is one of many orbital factories. Its uniqueness lies in its utilization of solar power. Enormous solar panels and a system of mirrors give the factory the appearance of a surrealistic tree. Whoever controls this factory holds a significant share of production in the Inner System.
station.Rachmaninoff.name: Rachmaninov-Energia
station.RebusSkyCity.desc: Rebus Sky City consists of several modules: residential, educational and business sections. Due to its location on the border of the Inner System, many tenants are tied to this orbital station. This means that the owner will enjoy an almost guaranteed source of rental income.
station.RebusSkyCity.name: Rebus Sky City
station.RedThrone.desc: The Civil Resistance HIS David came here from Bastion Oracle. Red Throne on Hecate is the main base of the Civil Resistance.
station.RedThrone.name: Red Throne
station.RedTiangong.desc: There are not many orbital factories operating on atomic energy beyond Earth’s orbit. Red Tiangong is one of them. Its proximity to the Outer System means that ownership of this property brings certain risks. It's unknown which of the workers sympathize with the Civil Resistance and are capable of sabotage. However, the property owner has the right to protect it by any means.
station.RedTiangong.name: Red Tiangong
station.Rhino.desc: A refueling station for cubecentric engine spacecraft that have business near the Sun.
station.Rhino.name: Rhino-4
station.RogueCity.desc: On Mars, Phobos and Deimos, colonies often combine opposite functions. Rogue City is a charging and repair terminal for ground vehicles, and at the same time serves as a corporate colony that brings constant rental dividends to its owner.
station.RogueCity.name: Rogue City
station.Rommel.desc: The largest mine on Annagerman. The oldest and most unreliable, too. Rommel is heavily rusted, and workers constantly abscond, but it still brings in profit. This means it is still a desirable asset.
station.Rommel.name: Rommel
station.SampoQuern.desc: This is a specialized plant for the production of robots and equipment for them.
station.SampoQuern.name: Sampo Quern
station.Schwerin.desc: A spaceport, combined with a refueling and repair station. No matter who owns Schwerin, there will always be shady dealings here. Crowds of idle, frenzied crew members wander its corridors while their spacecraft are being repaired. Corporate spies try to legitimize their presence through Schwerin. Fortune seekers who have earned a few dignitas in the asteroid mines of the Belt try to find more lucrative work here. Schwerin is always facing away from the Sun, in every sense.
station.Schwerin.name: Schwerin
station.Sewell.desc: A notable settlement on the surface of Hygiea. The colony of Sewell-2 is built around a still-functioning church erected by the original settlers. The owner of Sewell-2 advertises its commitment to preserving ancient traditions through the SBN.
station.Sewell.name: Sewell-2
station.ShepherdsArc.desc: A support dock for collecting ice boulders from the dense region of Saturn’s B Ring. The station’s owner holds a unique privilege: purchasing asteroids from the operators of cube-centric barges at very low cost, and then selling them into the System at a very high price.
station.ShepherdsArc.name: Shepherd's Arc
station.ShuCenter.desc: Shu Center is an information routing node. Thousands of petabytes of information pass through this information complex every hour. Almost everything coming from the Outer System to the Inner System goes through Shu Center.
station.ShuCenter.name: Shu Center
station.SinkholeOasis.desc: Karst Oasis is a geological research station on the edge of a Karst crater. Research into the geology of Mars has long disappointed many. The laboratory continues its work "out of habit." However, corporations usually don't tolerate idle expenses. And perhaps there is still something to study here.
station.SinkholeOasis.name: Sinkhole Oasis
station.Skylab.desc: Skylab is a expensive system of engineering test sites. Almost a quarter of patents in the Inner System are linked to inventions made here. Skylab brings its owners enormous daily profits.
station.Skylab.name: Skylab
station.SterlingsFarm.desc: A multi-level hydroponic factory for producing natural food. An important source of calories for the Inner System and a valuable asset.
station.SterlingsFarm.name: Sterling’s Farm
station.Stratagem.desc: A network of automatic relay platforms through which all communications with other stations pass. The station owner often gains a strategic advantage by being able to shut down competitors with the click of a button. Once it was a bastion of <color=#FFFEC1>SBN</color> in the External System, and now it regularly changes hands.
station.Stratagem.name: Ji-Stratagem
station.SubRosa.desc: This is a school for intelligence operatives. Tutors don’t care who owns the asset, as long as they are provided with a good life. Here, enormous resources are expended on the teaching of espionage, information extraction and interrogation.
station.SubRosa.name: Sub rosa
station.Sundog.desc: Maybe someday the Sundog Zone will become a full-fledged colony on Deimos. For now, this asset is only useful as a semi-secret transshipment base.
station.Sundog.name: Sundog Zone
station.SwiftAndVoltaire.desc: Swift and Voltaire is an unexpectedly large (by Martian standards) engineering and sociological laboratory, as well as an educational center. It is located neatly between the Swift and Voltaire craters.
station.SwiftAndVoltaire.name: Swift And Voltaire
station.TeslaRing.desc: An experimental complex where the <color=#FFFEC1>Tianming</color> Corporation tried to create an atmospheric particle accelerator. The project turned out to be too expensive. The station is abandoned, but from time to time bursts of plasma flash there, which attracts enthusiastic scientists studying anomalies.
station.TeslaRing.name: Great Tesla Ring
station.TSWatcher.desc: A fueling station and landing terminal for HIS. If you want to fly past the major ports of the Main Belt on your way to the Outer or Inner System, you'll definitely make a stop here.
station.TSWatcher.name: TS Watcher
station.TwinMiller.desc: A rotating processing cylinder set within the plane of Saturn’s rings. An orbital city-colony constructed by <color=#FFFEC1>Dilthey</color> with the cutting edge technologies. Life in the city is managed by a state-of-the-art AI known as <color=#FFFEC1>Summermute</color>.
station.TwinMiller.name: Twin Miller
station.Tycho.desc: Tycho Terminal is the main spaceport on the surface of the Moon. Interplanetary spacecraft rarely land here since AnCap Dogma Harbor is fairly close. However, transport shuttles are constantly landing and taking off here.
station.Tycho.name: Tycho Terminal
station.ValleyOfGeysers.desc: A colony built on the edge of a major rift that regularly vents plumes of water and ice. On its lower levels are descent shafts for autonomous drones dispatched deep into the moon’s fractures. During periods of heightened geyser activity, the station is sealed and placed in full isolation from the external environment.
station.ValleyOfGeysers.name: Valley of Geysers
station.VanDeGraaff.desc: An astronomical research center on the external side of Tsiolkovsky. Powerful telescopes and radar dishes are aimed at deep space here. There are rumors that the owners of this asset have set up an intelligence base here, under the guise of a research center.
station.VanDeGraaff.name: Van de Graaff
station.Vasa.desc: A city whose relative “topside” is always directed towards the Sun. The peculiarities of Geist's orbit and its control, carried out from Vasa, serve to always maintain this position. Special light concentrators, made according to Dilthey's strictly classified technology, allow the city to be illuminated so that it is even possible to maintain a real park in it.
station.Vasa.name: Vasa
station.VenusTwo.desc: This is a residential colony on HAVOC. It is the main source of labor in the Venusian cluster.
station.VenusTwo.name: Venus-2
station.Warden.desc: Warden-D is more of a warehouse system and staging post than a full-fledged colony. Life on Deimos is simple, even ascetic. The staff of such places typically consists of some hermits and religious fanatics.
station.Warden.name: Warden-D
station.WinterBay.desc: An intermediate orbital port serving asteroid catcher stations and ice-mining spacecrafts. It is equipped with hangars shielded against the ice particles constantly ejected from the surface of <color=#FFFEC1>Enceladus</color>. Direct landings on the moon from the station are prohibited, and no vessels from the surface may dock here. All communication between Enceladus and the wider Solar System is routed exclusively through the quarantine station <color=#FFFEC1>Mirage-12</color>.
station.WinterBay.name: Winter Bay
station.Zephyr.desc: A high-altitude spaceport, specially fortified to withstand the approach and docking of super-heavy spacecraft in Jupiter's gravity. The construction was started by the corporation <color=#FFFEC1>Dilthey</color> and completed by <color=#FFFEC1>PlanetBridge</color>. Owners use Zephyr to manage cargo flows between the Inner and Outer systems.
station.Zephyr.name: Zephyr
station.ZeroGravity.desc: This is the Zero Gravity Training Center. Experienced instructors will give your personnel extravehicular training for a reasonable fee.
station.ZeroGravity.name: 0G TC
station.Zeus.desc: An electricity-generating station. A giant frame with antennas that catch lightning. The resulting energy is stored in special superconducting storage devices and then sent to orbital factories. Here you can always see spacecraft-batteries, transporting electricity throughout the System. The station staff is gradually going crazy from the constant noise of the discharges.
station.Zeus.name: Zeus Mk. III
station.Zhukov.desc: Zhukov is a relatively new mine, built by a proxy of an unknown corporation. The patron managed to cover their tracks too well, so no one knows the identity of the real builder of Zhukov. Some factors hint that it could be one of the hexarchs. The station is well protected from the natural features of Annagerman and working here is relatively comfortable. But everything really is relative. Since this asset is a stable source of lithium, it is extremely fiercely contested.
station.Zhukov.name: Zhukov
